items.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: We’ve done several with a company called Jazzdagen... The principal, Alita Myers... The thought was that it would be interesting to combine our kind of music... with her trad music

ctx.x: So now you’re doing also the jazz cruises?
Well yes. We’ve done several with a company called Jazzdagen, which is interesting because Jazzdagen essentially has presented cruises, they put on maybe seven or eight or © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

even more a year, mostly with trad band groups. The principal, Alita Myers, her husband is a wonderful clarinet player and he leads a group called High Sierra, which is a well recognized trad band that plays these festivals and such. And the thought was that it would be interesting to combine our kind of music, our all-star music, with her trad music, to broaden the audience. I felt it would be nice because it would expose — that’s tough, it’s tough to compete with somebody drilling in the streets — but it would…
